newsitem.title: USA: CFTC sets ag options hearings in Illinois & Tenn..
newsitem.headline: CFTC sets ag options hearings in Illinois & Tenn..

text.p: Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Thursday it would hold public hearings in Bloomington, Ill., and Memphis, Tenn., next month on whether the agency should lift its longstanding ban on agricultural trade options.
In a notice published in the Federal Register, CFTC said a meeting was set for July 10 at Illinois State University and July 16 at University of Memphis.

Requests to present oral and written testimony at the hearings should be sent to the CFTC by fax, e-mail or letter, the agency said. Earlier this month, the CFTC said it would accept comments until July 24 on its proposal to lift the ban.
